summary.zh: 按路由补齐接口测试，覆盖鉴权、校验与边界
summary.en: Write API and contract tests from your routes, including edge cases.

description.zh: 读接口路由，为每个端点生成正常路径、鉴权失败、参数校验和边界情况的测试，可直接组成集成或契约测试。适合新接口补测试、老接口缺覆盖的时候。运行测试需要项目本身能启动。
description.en: Reads route definitions and writes tests for each endpoint: happy paths, auth failures, validation errors and edge cases, as an integration or contract suite. Use it to cover new endpoints or fill gaps in old ones. The project must start.
